summary: Implemented the SHACL path parsing utility. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test plus non-node and graph-unchanged tests. Running the new tests and test/test_path.py gives 42 passed, using the prepared venv's Python. Nothing was committed. mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placements and black-style wrapping were checked by reading only.
